notes.title: Bloody Painter Dating Sim Valentine DLC - 1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
Voice replay is now available! Additionally, two new language translations have been added.

[h2][b]● Update Content:  [/b][/h2]
1. Added text history review.  
2. Added voice replay feature.  
3. Added French translation (Translation by Niyuuh & Choup).  
4. Added Portuguese translation (Translation by Paulina Husarek).

[h2][b]● Download and Play "Bloody Painter Dating Sim"[/b][/h2]
Main Game: [url=https://delucat.itch.io/bloody-painter-dating-sim]https://delucat.itch.io/bloody-painter-dating-sim[/url]
DLC Valentine: [url=https://delucat.itch.io/bloody-painter-dating-sim-dlc-valentines-day]https://delucat.itch.io/bloody-painter-dating-sim-dlc-valentines-day[/url]

[b]● Regarding whether the BP Valentine DLC will be released on Steam: [/b] [url=https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1MEdeY2JXn/]https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1MEdeY2JXn/[/url]
